t: What Structural Load Case Database Is All About
title: What Structural Load Case Database Is All About
description: Structural load cases are the demands a structure must survive: dead loads (self-weight), live loads (people, furniture: 40 psf residential floors), wind (ASCE 7 maps), snow, seismic (spectral response), and combinations (1.2D + 1.6L). LRFD factors loads up and resistance down; the structure must stand under every factored combination. Tacoma taught wind dynamics; codes encode the lessons. This database is the complete load case: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
